text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wooww...! There are... so many people...!
And everyone's eyes are sparkling...

On this day, I was visiting to watch the Tenno Sho (Spring)
with Rice Shower. The reason being...

—One week ago,
during training with Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*~... *pant*~...
Rice-san~... Please wait up-~...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh? Y... Y-Yes?

(She is Sakura Bakushin O.
Rice Shower's classmate, and a girl who specializes in short distances, but—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, to tell the truth, I've been running alongside you
on my own to fulfill my duties as Class Rep.
choice_data_list: (So she was running alongside me without me even noticing...)
(She was pacing alongside me on her own the whole time...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Rice-san's stamina is truly magnificent! Which is why I'd like to make a proposal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go watch the Tenno Sho (Spring) together!?
As fellow wielders of speed capable of conquering long distances!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Together...? The Tenno... Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, together! Finding a friend's hidden strength and cooperating is part of the class rep's duty!

“—Though it's not hidden, just as Sakura Bakushin O said,
Rice Shower has the makings of a long-distance... stayer.”

The Tenno Sho (Spring) will surely become
one of the stages she aims for in time.
choice_data_list: Shall we go to Kyoto to check it out?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A... Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I was lonely going by myself!
By the way, snacks are capped at 300 yen, okay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...This feels kind of like a field trip.
Ehehe, I'm so excited...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now into the 4th corner, passing the 600m-to-go marker,
here comes... Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah! McQueen!!
Run all the way to the finish like thattt!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~! What a heated battle!
I'm going to get closer to watch it, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen continues to pull away!
The Umamusume behind her give desperate chase, but—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —She can't reach her! Nobody can catch up to her!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen with a brilliant burst of speed!
Crossing the finish line in a spectacular first place!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations...!
Congratulations, McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for your cheers!
I was only able to win thanks to all of you...!
(Waaaaaaahhhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: I couldn't take my eyes off it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! It was amazing.
So strong... and so dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The further ahead McQueen-san got,
the more everyone watching began to smile...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It was just like the "Blue Rose" in the picture book!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's right, a blue rose that brings happiness to everyone!
From the mouth of an excited Rice Shower came the story of the picture book about the blue rose—"The Blue Rose of Happiness."
A single blue rosebud that suddenly bloomed in a garden filled with roses.
People feared this unprecedented variety of rose, shunning it as a 'Flower of Misfortune.'

Yet one day, a young man bought that flower.
"It's truly wonderful," he said.

And by the window of that young man's... Big Brother's house,
the blue rose bloomed. It was wondrously beautiful—

And by the window of that young woman's... Big Sister's house,
the blue rose bloomed. It was wondrously beautiful—

Bringing smiles and...
happiness to the hearts of passersby, day after day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... McQueen-san has been loved right from the start,
so it might be a little different for her, though.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Rice wants to become one, too.
An Umamusume who brings happiness, not misfortune.
choice_data_list: If it's you, Rice Shower, you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
You don't have to flatter me like that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Still, if only... if only I could do it.

...On that day, I decided to stay and watch
Mejiro McQueen for just a little longer before heading home.
